sources.label: KK Yap & Associates XSGD SCS Reserve Account Report — 31 May 2026

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-07-28: KK Yap & Associates SSAE 3000 (Revised) examination as of 31 May 2026 11:59 PM ST still reports Cash SGD 15,013,117 and Bonds/notes ≤3 months residual maturity issued by MAS/government (or overnight reverse repos against AA-/Aa3 counterparties) SGD 11,569,694, totaling SGD 26,582,811 marked-to-market reserves versus SGD 26,568,488 XSGD in circulation. Percentages 56.476785% cash and 43.523215% short-dated MAS/government bills or eligible overnight reverse repos are calculated against that reserve total and re-derived on re-open. StraitsX legal disclosures (effective 18 July 2026) independently corroborate 100% reserve backing in segregated trust accounts at MAS-permitted FIs (CIMB, DBS, SCB or other permitted FIs), held on trust for token-holders and excluded from the issuer's unsecured-creditor estate. The examination does not split the second category between bills and repos or name the safeguarding institution. StraitsX /xsgd attestation list still tops out at 31 May 2026 as of this re-open (no later public report located).
